mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates economic expansion, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but SPX returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and equity prices.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 5% but SPX returns are negative in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production and employment indicate strong economic activity, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Both series increase, but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may reduce borrowing, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4% but SPX returns are positive in over 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive economic growth and returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase, but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation may lead to rate hikes, negatively impacting equity valuations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 240 but SPX returns are positive in over 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales and low interest rates indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases and FEDFUNDS are low, but SPX returns are negative in over 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment in late expansion may signal an impending slowdown, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4% but SPX returns are positive in over 50% of cases.
